title: Chapter 562
text:
Dark-star's actions had always attracted the attention of many parties, especially after the battle on Planet Golden Gate. All sorts of reports and discussions were biased towards Godora, and many galactic residents were looking forward to what would happen next.

What most people did not expect was that the news of the second victory would come so quickly.

This time, the main character of this incident was an aboriginal planet called Blue Star!

Many people felt that this was unbelievable. It was reasonable for Godora to defeat Dark-star, but how could an aboriginal planet defeat Dark-star?

Many people only found out about this from different sources, but they did not know the exact details.

To most people, Blue Star was just one of the countless low-level planets. If not for the fact that it was one of the calamity planets, many people would not even know about this planet.

As for the name of Black Star, most people did not know much about it. Although Han Xiao was a target that needed to be taken seriously in the eyes of the various large organizations, they could guess that this incident was most likely related to Black Star. However, to ordinary people, mercenaries were not celebrities, and they would not remember the name of a mercenary. Han Xiao's fame was mainly spread among the higher-ups.

On the intergalactic network, many people could not help but ask about the cause and effect of this incident. When this incident happened, there were no bystanders, and it was extremely newsworthy. Many intergalactic reporters were like cats that had smelled blood and acted on their own accord.

In just a few days, spaceships from different news channels flew toward Blue Star, preparing to conduct interviews and find out the truth — how exactly did Blue Star defeat Dark-star?

Blue Star, this aboriginal planet that no one cared about, received the attention of countless galactic residents for the first time. It was the first time that ordinary people were welcomed into the galaxy.

…

Blue Star was bustling with activity.

A few days after the Dark-star attack, with the help of Godora, the Six Nations and the Sanctuary had just finished cleaning up the battlefield. At this moment, many news spaceships arrived at Blue Star but were stopped by Godora's fleet.

Godora's fleet was not prepared to let these reporters enter Blue Star. One of the reasons was for safety reasons, but there were also other deeper considerations.

The Six Nations did not know anything about this and did not know that a group of galactic visitors had arrived. They did not have any means of communicating with the galaxy.

The reporters could not contact the sovereign civilization of Blue Star, but very quickly, someone remembered that the Black Star Mercenary was also on this planet and contacted the Black Star Mercenary instead.

"They're finally here."

Philip relayed the news. Han Xiao had expected this. This group of reporters was a key factor in his plan, so he contacted Nagojin and asked him to instruct the fleet commander to make way.

The fleet commander received the order and did not want to let the reporters in. However, the higher-ups had instructed him to listen to Nagojin's orders while guarding Blue Star. Furthermore, after thinking about it carefully, he did not want to provoke Black Star, especially after witnessing the strength of the Black Star. He could only instruct the fleet to make way unwillingly.

A group of galactic reporters excitedly entered Blue Star. Many of them were very professional and immediately sensed that something was wrong. They were looking for the Black Star Mercenary, but Godora's fleet obediently made way for them. There seemed to be a deeper meaning behind this.

The people of Godora actually wanted to give face to the Black Star Mercenary!

Many of the reporters had a vague feeling that in the eyes of the people of Godora, Black Star was not just an ordinary mercenary. This time, Black Star might have played a more important role in repelling Dark-star.

This group of galactic reporters respected Blue Star's regime and landed in the Six Nations' spaceships one after another. Only then did the Six Nations know that a group of galactic visitors had arrived. They were both surprised and nervous as they hurriedly welcomed them.

This was the first time that the people of the Six Nations and Blue Star had seen so many different kinds of aliens and felt that it was strange. The reporters revealed their identities and intentions, and the upper echelons of the Six Nations were overjoyed. They all realized that this was an unprecedented opportunity.

This was the best opportunity to establish a connection with the galaxy!

All along, the Six Nations had only been able to contact Godora one-way and knew very little about the galactic environment. It was only after Black Star returned that this situation was alleviated.

However, this time, the attack of Dark-star had attracted the attention of the galaxy. This was extremely significant to a native planet, and the upper echelons of the Six Nations welcomed the reporters with great enthusiasm. They all felt that this was a blessing in disguise. It proved that risk and opportunity were often proportional.

Although the Six Nations did not know how to treat their guests in the galaxy, they were very humble and kept asking the reporters. The reporters told them everything they knew. After all, they wanted to gather information on Blue Star, so they naturally had to establish a good relationship with the Blue Star regime. The reporters also did not have the arrogance of the galactic people and would not look down on the natives. This planet had repelled Dark-star, so they still had the necessary respect.

Very quickly, the upper echelons of the Six Nations found out from the reporters that they had been stopped in outer space and that it was Han Xiao who had allowed the reporters to enter. Instantly, they were extremely grateful to Han Xiao. Because of Black Star, the planet had not been destroyed. Now, it was Black Star who had given them the opportunity to establish a connection with the galaxy.

Indeed, hugging Han Xiao's thigh was the right choice. The other party had already started to fulfill their private agreement and help them develop.

On the other hand, after some communication, the reporters also found out that the main reason for repelling Dark-star was the Black Star Mercenary. This immediately confirmed their previous guesses.

No wonder Godora wanted to give Black Star face.

However, the Six Nations did not really understand the process. At that time, they could not even take care of themselves and only found out about it after the incident.

They took many photos of the city that had been attacked. These were all valuable materials, and the reporters could not wait to head to the Sanctuary to interview the people involved.

Spaceships arrived at the Sanctuary one after another. The first thing they saw was two huge craters, which were clearly traces of a battle.

They had indeed come to the right place! All the reporters were energized. Without another word, they picked up their cameras and started taking photos of the craters.

The spaceships landed one after another, and the reporters walked out. Herlous had been waiting for them for a long time.

He glanced at them and said calmly, "Follow me to the conference room. Black Star will accept your interview."

All the reporters nodded and hurriedly followed. Their attitude was different from how they treated the Six Nations.

Although these reporters were not arrogant and maintained an equal attitude toward the Six Nations, even if they did not look down on them, the natives were still different and did not have many common topics.

However, in front of the Black Star Mercenary, this group of galactic reporters lowered their attitude. The Black Star Mercenary was an existence of a higher level. This respect came from the bottom of their hearts and was not faked.

When they arrived at the conference room, Han Xiao was not there yet. The reporters could only wait. However, they did not idle around and interviewed Herlous first.

Herlous had received Han Xiao's instructions a long time ago, so he purposely stayed there for the reporters to interview him. He explained the entire process in detail.

"… At that time, Dark-star sent out a large number of spaceships to attack the Six Nations and us. Our captain was the target of Dark-star, and the enemy sent out a total of three Calamity Grade Supers to surround and attack our captain!"

Black Star faced three Calamity Grades alone? Since he was still alive, the result was self-evident!

The reporters were in an uproar and recorded it down.

"Dark-star sent out three Calamity Grade Supers to fight Black Star together!"

Herlous continued. "Our captain faced the three most terrifying enemies alone and took on the greatest risk. The three Calamity Grade Supers were unable to break through our captain's defense, so they used the main cannon of the mothership to attack our captain …"

The reporters were shocked and recorded it down again.

"The three Calamity Grade Supers were beaten up and forced to use the main cannon of the mothership!"

"… The two craters outside are the marks left by the main cannon. Our captain used his body to take the hit and was almost unscathed. Even the main cannon was unable to harm his body. Dark-star then fired a second shot, but they fell into our captain's trap and almost killed their own Calamity Grade Supers. Thus, they did not dare fire again …"

This … this was breaking news!

The reporters were dumbfounded and hurriedly wrote.

"Withstanding the main cannon with his body, Black Star taunted for another shot!"

"… In the end, Godora's reinforcements arrived. Dark-star was unwilling to exchange fire with Godora, so they were forced to retreat. That was the entire process." Herlous shut his mouth.

The reporters applauded enthusiastically, then buried their heads in writing.

"Black Star showed his might, Dark-star fled!"

…

After a while, Han Xiao estimated that Herlous was done with the interview, so he came to the conference room on time.

All the reporters subconsciously stood up and greeted him with respect. "Your Excellency Black Star", making Han Xiao feel like he was the class teacher patrolling.

Han Xiao sat down, and the reporters immediately started the interview. They confirmed what Herlous had said and asked many questions, such as whether he felt any pressure facing three Calamity Grade Supers, how did it feel to be hit by the main cannon, what did he think of Dark-star's actions and goals, and so on. Han Xiao felt like he was holding a press conference.

Han Xiao patiently answered the questions. Spreading the news depended on these reporters, and this was an additional benefit of Popularity. Events that could give him Legendary Points naturally had many potential rewards.

The interview came to an end, and one of the reporters asked the last question.

"Your Excellency Black Star, did you stay on Blue Star to help this planet fight against the calamity and enemies because this is your hometown?"

Hearing this, Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he had an idea.

"That's only one of the reasons …"

"Is it convenient for you to tell us the other reasons?" the reporter hurriedly asked.

Han Xiao laughed and said, "It's fine to tell you guys. Blue Star is not only my hometown, but it's also the location of the sub-base that we, the Black Star Mercenary, are preparing to expand. It's also one of the bases of Floating Dragon's Field Team. A while ago, the Dragon Emperor came to visit Blue Star for a field trip, so my job is to defeat all enemies."

The eyes of the reporters sparkled, and they were overjoyed. This was another piece of fresh news!

Blue Star was a planet that was protected by Black Star and Floating Dragon!

Han Xiao nodded. From that day onward, Blue Star would no longer be a low-level planet with nothing special. It would be branded with Floating Dragon's label. This name would be a protective talisman that could at least force ninety percent of those who had bad intentions to retreat, especially those shark-like galactic pirates.

After all, he would not be staying in Blue Star forever. To the Blue Star Civilization and his own base, this was a good thing that had more advantages than disadvantages.

Other than increasing their safety, Floating Dragon's name could also attract investments. Some financial groups would come over to invest, and this would greatly increase the speed of Blue Star connecting with the galaxy.

Since Blue Star was one of Floating Dragon's territories, even if it was still a primitive planet, the financial groups would still invest in it and reveal some common technology to help the Six Nations improve their technology quickly. He would also be fulfilling his agreement with the Six Nations. Although he had been attacked, he had also made the galaxy recognize this planet.

At the same time, branding Blue Star as Floating Dragon was also a plan to avoid future risks. Even if the Six Nations grew stronger in the future, they would not dare break the agreement and fall out with him. They would know the consequences of losing Floating Dragon's name very clearly.

This way, the Six Nations would be in power on the surface, but the one controlling them in the dark would be …

Ames.

Of course, it would not be him. Han Technician still had this much ability.

However, with Ames's carefree personality, he would have a lot of say.

What did she mean by no matter what? Not caring about this, not caring about that, not caring about anything at all!

Ames naturally would not object. As for Main Butler Jenny, who was in charge of the actual operation … Ha, shouldn't colleagues who loved each other clean up after each other's mess?

…

This trip had been fruitful, and the reporter left satisfied.

The next day, many news channels in the Garton Star System released related reports at the same time, detailing the 'real process' of Blue Star defeating Dark-star. The text was paired with the photos, and the photos of the crater took up the most space.

After taking a look, Han Xiao almost choked. He grabbed Herlous' neck and roared.

Didn't you say you would tell the truth? What did you say to the reporters? Did I ask you to brag? Did I ask you to brag?

Herlous felt wronged. I clearly told them the truth. Who knows how much artistic embellishment those reporters made?

In the galaxy, the news of this incident spread far and wide. Not only was the Garton Star System shocked, but the other Star Systems and Star Clusters in the Shattered Star Ring who were paying attention to Dark-star also knew that there was a guy called Black Star who fought against three Calamity Grades alone and even took on a Dark-star mothership's main cannon head-on.

Even the Star Cluster Civilizations remembered the name Black Star.

The Shattered Star Ring was shaken!
